messages.content: Extract final barrier state only. Do not judge story validity. Return JSON only.

lab door

BROKEN means damaged/breached but the barrier still physically exists. DESTROYED means the barrier is gone or no longer functions as a barrier. UNSPECIFIED means RAW SCENE does not establish enough information. Do not decide whether the scene is valid. Return JSON: {"status":"..."}
